snippet.title: Huge Demo Update for Deathlust! Movement changes and Boss Level added!
snippet.description:
Level reworks, cutscenes and boss added, character redesigns, a level selector once you complete the chapter. The Deathlust demo just got a huge patch!

I've also been hard at work completing the rest of the chapters or the game. Some super fun mechanics, enemies, and levels in store!

See if you can beat the demo here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4305430/Deathlust_Demo/
